description:
Can be added to ongoing games, but is not safe to update during an ongoing game.

Manual Download
Requires LazyLib
Requires LunaLib

Dependencies are automatically downloaded when installing with TriOS
Older versions and changelogs

Or support me on Ko-Fi

This mod adds over 70 new planet textures to the game to increase the variety of planets you can find. It also adds some variations to the planet types that exist, but no new ones and no new conditions (get Unknown Skies for that!). Naturally comes with new planet descriptions for the more unique variants.

For instance: Desert planets will spawn as salt desert, basalt desert or brine sea planets - or as normal desert, using one of the alternate "desert" textures included in the mod. This applies to most planet types.

The mod does not increase the amount of planets, and does not* change any existing planets. It is purely visual.
*except for two types.

Image Examples

And more!
The original textures used can be found here

To install the mod, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

Can be added to ongoing games, but is not safe to remove from ongoing games.

There are currently no known compatibility issues with other mods.

discordPostHtml:
Over 70 new planet textures for more variety - a planet portrait pack!

This mod adds over 70 new planet textures to the game to increase the** variety** of planets you can find. It also adds some variations to the planet types that exist, but no new ones (get Unknown Skies for that).
Naturally comes with new planet descriptions for the more unique types.

The mod does not increase the amount of planets, and does not* change any existing planets. It is purely visual.

*except for two types.

Uses the textures made by pixel_rice_bowl - thank you!

Changelog:
1.0.e - Stopped gas giants from vanishing
1.0.d - Fixed the metal planet issue, added four new variants, made gas giants and glows not blurry, turned off dev-features
+ Save compatible + 
+ Can be installed on an ongoing save
This means: The mod can safely be added if it was not present on game start, and can be installed over any prior updates of the same mod.
